transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. How can I help you today?

Um... I guess I'm here because my sleep has kind of... fallen apart lately. I just lie in bed for hours. 

My laptop will be closed, but my brain is still just... going over things. Rechecking work deadlines, and tuition payments, and class assignments. And... I don't know, even when I actually do manage to sleep, I wake up feeling like I never really turned off.
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy lately?
Um... no, not really. I don't think so. I wouldn't say I feel hopeless or anything like that. Just... mostly just tired from not sleeping.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about things, even when you know they might not happen, and does it feel hard to control those worries?

Yeah... I guess I do. It's... it is hard to control, I suppose. 

I try to tell myself to just stop, you know, and focus on one thing. But... one thought just immediately leads to another. And then I'm just... checking my calendar, or looking at my budget, or my assignments... just over and over again. I end up not actually getting anything done.
Do you notice that these thoughts and worries happen even when there isn’t a specific stressor or problem to solve, or do they only come up when something is particularly pressing?

Um... I suppose it's kind of all the time. Not just when there's a big problem. 

My mind just... jumps around a lot. Like, from whether I'm falling behind at work, to... if I'm just wasting money on school. And... I don't know, I guess I worry my family will think I can't handle things. 

It just feels like... every small issue could somehow derail my whole future. So... yeah, it doesn't really need a specific stressor to start.
Do you ever feel physically restless, like you can't sit still, or as if you're always on edge?
Um... no, I don't think so. I haven't really noticed anything like that. I... mostly just feel tired, like I said.
Do you find that you feel fatigued or low on energy most days, even if you haven’t been doing anything physically demanding?

Yeah... I do. Um... by midafternoon at the office, I just feel... completely drained. 

It's like... even just answering emails or, I don't know, walking to the subway after work... it just takes so much effort. And... even if I rest all weekend, it doesn't really seem to give me my energy back. I just always feel... tired.
Do you find it hard to concentrate or focus on tasks because your mind keeps drifting to these worries?

Yeah... I guess so. Um... sometimes I'll just be staring at a financial model at work, or... a reading for class. And I'll realize I've reread the same paragraph like five times without really absorbing anything. My head is just... already off running through everything that could go wrong.
Have you ever experienced periods where you felt down or sad most of the time, even when there wasn’t an obvious reason for it?
Um... no, not really. I don't think I've had that. I mean, I get stressed out a lot, but... I wouldn't say I just feel sad for no reason.
Do you often feel that even when you do sleep, it’s not refreshing or restful, like you’re not really getting the kind of rest your body needs?

Yeah... I guess that's the main reason I'm here. My sleep is just... it's fallen apart. 

Um... I'll just lie there in my apartment for hours. Laptop closed, but... my brain is still just going. Rechecking work deadlines, worrying about tuition, class assignments... everything. And then... when I do finally fall asleep, I wake up feeling like I never even turned off. It's just not... restful.
Have you been experiencing ongoing anxiety or worry that's lasted for most days over the past six months, even before your sleep problems got worse?

Yeah... I suppose so. It's been going on for a while. Um... my mind just kind of jumps around a lot. Like... worrying if I'm falling behind at work, or... if I'm just wasting money on school. And... I guess I worry my family will think I can't handle things. It just feels like... every small issue could just derail my whole future. So, yeah... it's been most days.
Do you find yourself especially anxious or worried about your sleep itself, like being afraid you won’t be able to fall asleep or stay asleep?
Um... I don't know. I guess I just... I worry about a lot of things. I don't think I'm specifically focused on the sleep part, it's just... everything else keeping me awake.
When you're trying to fall asleep, do you find that your thoughts are racing or going around in circles, making it hard for you to actually fall asleep?
Um... I'm not really sure if they race, exactly. I just... I just think about the things I mentioned before. It just keeps me awake, I guess.
When you're trying to fall asleep, do you find that your thoughts are going so fast that you can't quiet your mind, making it hard to actually fall asleep?
Um... I think I just answered that. It's... it's just the same things I was talking about before. My mind doesn't really go fast, it just... won't shut off, I guess.
Do you find that your worries tend to jump around to different areas of your life—like work, school, family, and finances—rather than focusing on just one specific thing?

Um... yeah, I suppose. It doesn't really stay on one thing. I'll just be thinking about... like, if I'm falling behind at work. And then it's... I don't know, if I'm wasting money on school. Or my family... worrying if they think I can't handle things. It just feels like... like every little issue is going to completely derail my whole future, I guess.
Do you ever notice any physical symptoms, like muscle tension, headaches, or stomach issues, that seem to come up when you're feeling anxious or worried?
Um... no, not really. I don't think so. I mean... I haven't really noticed anything like that. Just... just the worrying, mostly.
Do you often feel anxious or worried specifically in situations where you feel you're being judged or evaluated by others, like speaking in front of people or meeting new individuals?
Um... no, I don't think so. I mean, meeting new people is... it's fine, I guess. I don't really worry about them judging me, or anything like that. It's mostly just... the other things I mentioned.
